reference.name: csem_paper_kl_f8_lwd
reference.basis: Zhou et al., TGRS 2026, DOI:10.1109/TGRS.2026.3661733, equations (12)-(13)
reference.status: CSEM paper method adapted to LWD; unpublished implementation details are explicit assumptions.
assumptions: Paper II-B: pretrained KL-f8, mean RGB-to-gray weights, pixel L2 + frozen image-feature L2 + KL; whole VAE fine-tuned.
Original CompVis KL-f8 OpenImages checkpoint is selected; identity with the authors private initialization is not established.
Elementwise pixel MSE; ImageNet-normalized AlexNet ReLU [1,4,7,9,11] feature MSE averaged across layers; KL summed per sample then batch mean.

feature_weight=1, SGD lr=1e-3 momentum=0.9 weight_decay=5e-4, float16 AMP and 10 epochs come from the 2026-11-08 lwd_v1 pilots (docs/validation/20261108_lwd_v1_pilot.json); the cosine decay to 1e-5 addresses the global-offset drift seen in the lwd_v1 run (docs/validation/20261109_lwd_v1_full_training.json); kl_weight is re-checked by lwd_v2 pilots. None are recovered CSEM final hyperparameters.
No LPIPS calibration, TV/gradient loss, discriminator, EMA or loss-weight schedule; the learning rate follows optimizer.schedule.

LWD image grid is the planned square inversion grid of datasets lwd_v2-lwd_v4: 128x128 cells of 1 inch (10.67 ft), global y-z frame centred on the window; F-order flattening (z fastest) is the inversion parameter order; manifest train/val splits; best model selected by validation log10rho RMSE.
